answer: Audits are recorded in falcon, queued in juniper, and forge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 25 identities per epoch. A farm of 89 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4452 identities would post 2275 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
